matchup.plan_md:
- **ESPN sync:** no new moves; Kawhi kept (Plan A).
- **Score:** **720 to 687, up 33.**
- **Adds:** 3 of 7 used, **4 left**.
- **Projection** (`--rotate "Jrue Holiday@2026-11-12" "Isaiah Hartenstein@2026-11-12" "Jalen Smith@2026-11-15"`):
  - with no more moves: 1,437 to 1,513;
  - with the 4-add plan (+130.6): **1,568 to 1,513**.

| Adds | vs keeping | Moves |
|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | +65.4 | Nov 12 Holiday → P.J. Washington |
| 2 | +96.4 | + Nov 15 Smith → Jordan Goodwin |
| 3 | +119.2 | Nov 12 Holiday → Washington; Nov 14 Hartenstein → Daniel Gafford; Nov 15 Smith → Goodwin |
| 4 | **+130.6** | Nov 12 Holiday → Washington; Nov 14 Hartenstein → Day'Ron Sharpe; Nov 15 Sharpe → Goodwin and Smith → Devin Vassell |

**The plan is confirmed.**

1. **P.J. Washington** is a free agent: rate 31.0; season 29.5 (11), L7 34.8 (4), L15 28.4 (7), L30 29.5 (11). His L7 is 5.3 over on the same minutes: output, not role.
2. **Jalen Smith** kept the start on 11 Nov, with Claxton off the bench ([NBC Sports, 11 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-11/jalen-smith-scores-team-high-23-points-vs-spurs)).
   - Smith: 48 FP in 30 min. Rate 41.0; season 33.2 (10) → 35.8 (9); L7 35.7 (3) → 48.5 (2), a small sample; L15 36.8 (6) → 42.2 (5).
   - Claxton: 34 FP in 16 min. Season 29.0 (2), a small sample.
3. **Devin Vassell** missed 11 Nov too, his second straight game with the adductor ([RotoWire, 11 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/devin-vassell-injury-wont-play-wednesday-538652)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 13 Nov.
   - He stays the Nov 15 pick for now, but check his status before 9:00 AM Mon 16.
   - Fallback: **Aday Mara** (OKC @SAC, 1:00 PM Mon 16). Rate 29.1; season 25.3 (12), L7 32.4 (5), L15 29.6 (8), L30 25.3 (12). His L7 is 7.1 over, on more minutes with Holmgren and Jalen Williams out.
4. **Norman Powell** missed 11 Nov; *ESPN est.* 13 Nov. He is not in Plan A.

**Our injuries:**
- **Caleb Wilson** left 11 Nov in the third quarter with a right hand injury, after 15 points in 15 minutes. Splitter had no update, and more is expected Thursday ([ESPN, 11 Nov](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50458612/bulls-rookie-caleb-wilson-leaves-game-right-hand-injury); [CBS, 11 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/bulls-caleb-wilson-wont-return-wednesday/)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 13 Nov.
  - Rate 28.8; season 34.9 (10), L7 17.7 (3), L15 33.5 (6), L30 34.9 (10).
  - His L7 is 17.2 under: the 15-minute exit on 11 Nov, and 3 FP in 22 min on 4 Nov.
- **Scottie Barnes:** still listed out (left groin). No report on Nov 12 at PHI yet, and no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 12 Nov. The plan counts him back Nov 12, but only 2 of ours play that day, so his absence changes no move.
- **Trey Murphy III:** now listed out (knees); no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 13 Nov. He missed 11 Nov.
- **Paul George:** day-to-day (illness); his next game is 15 Nov; *ESPN est.* 15 Nov.
- **Holiday:** rate 27.7; season 29.5 (11), L7 23.0 (5), L15 29.4 (9). His L7 is 6.5 under, on unchanged minutes: output, with no report found.
- **Hartenstein:** rate 33.0; season 31.5 (12), L7 34.2 (5), L15 33.1 (8).

news-watch.changed_md:
**Our players:**
- **Trey Murphy III:** doubtful tonight (11 Nov vs BKN) on the official injury report, with bilateral patellar tendinopathy and "at least one more game" out ([NBC Sports, 11 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-11/trey-murphy-knee-now-doubtful-vs-brooklyn)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 11 Nov is too early. **Override added:** sit 11 Nov. He sat the second night of the last back-to-back, so NOP's 13–14 Nov back-to-back is a risk, but nothing is announced.
- **Paul George:** out tonight with an illness. "His next opportunity to play will come Sunday" (Celtics' Taylor Snow, via [CBS, 11 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/celtics-paul-george-out-wednesday/)). *ESPN est.* 15 Nov matches.
- **Caleb Wilson:** questionable tonight with right hip soreness, a late addition to the report ([CBS, 11 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/bulls-caleb-wilson-late-addition-to-injury-report/)); *ESPN est.* 11 Nov. He has not missed a game this season.
- **Scottie Barnes:** out tonight with a left groin strain, his third straight game. No timetable reported ([TSN, 11 Nov](https://www.tsn.ca/nba/article/shorthanded-raptors-look-to-turn-fortunes-around-against-celtics-on-tsn/)); *ESPN est.* 12 Nov, which looks optimistic for the second night of a back-to-back.
- **Jalen Smith:** still the Bulls' starting center while Claxton's 16–20-minute limit lasts. It has no end date ([NBC Sports, 8 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-08/nic-claxton-hamstring-plays-18-minutes-sunday)).
- **Kawhi Leonard:** the Raptors give an update in a week, about 17 Nov ([Yardbarker, 10 Nov](https://www.yardbarker.com/nba/articles/raptors_announce_kawhi_leonard_will_miss_more_time_as_he_recovers_from_left_knee_injury/s1_16751_44544586)); *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
- **Jalen Duren:** "at least two more weeks" as of 9 Nov, re-evaluated about 22 Nov; *ESPN est.* 24 Nov.

**Lauri Birds:**
- They dropped **Lauri Markkanen**: two nondisplaced right-hand fractures, re-evaluated in four weeks, about 9 Dec ([Yardbarker, 11 Nov](https://www.yardbarker.com/nba/articles/jazzs_lauri_markkanen_out_with_hand_fractures_to_be_reevaluated_in_four_weeks/s1_17038_44548155)); *ESPN est.* 4 Jan.
- **Jamal Shead's** starts end when Immanuel Quickley returns. Quickley is questionable tonight; no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 11 Nov.
- **Stephen Curry** has no back-to-back this week.

**Targets:**
- **Yves Missi:** out through at least 17 Nov. **Override changed** from return 12 Nov to 18 Nov, a floor.
- **Maxime Raynaud:** week-to-week. **Override added:** return 16 Nov, a floor.
- **Daniss Jenkins:** his start is game by game until Duren returns.
- **Aday Mara:** a steady backup-center role behind Hartenstein, 18–27 minutes.
- **Devin Vassell** and **Norman Powell:** game-time decisions tonight.
- **P.J. Washington** and **Day'Ron Sharpe:** clear.
